title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in Drainage Systems
description: Selecting between hubless cast iron and schedule 40 PVC for drain, waste, and vent (DWV) systems depends on specific performance requirements. Cast iron piping excels in acoustic insulation, significantly dampening the sound of cascading wastewater inside walls, and provides superior fire resistance for commercial and multi-family structures. PVC piping is lightweight, highly resistant to chemical corrosion, and economical for standard residential construction. However, PVC transfers acoustic vibration more readily and requires allowance for thermal expansion. Professional plumbers select drainage materials by balancing local code mandates, sound control demands, and structural conditions.
